tagline: A residential Asian side district on the slopes above Ataşehir — elevated positions with city views, a growing café scene, and a quieter alternative to the busy valley below.

items.name: Kayışdağı Semt Kafeleri
items.description: A handful of neighbourhood cafés that have opened as the district's population has grown. Relaxed and affordable.

items.name: Kayışdağı Ormanı
items.description: A forest area on the Kayışdağı ridge used for walking and jogging by locals. A rare green patch on the inner Asian side.

items.name: Panoramik Manzara Noktaları
items.description: The elevated streets of Kayışdağı offer sweeping views over Ataşehir and towards the Bosphorus on clear days.

items.name: Semt Restoranları
items.description: Local restaurants serving Turkish home cooking and grills to the neighbourhood's residents.

tips: Bus routes connect Kayışdağı to Ataşehir metro stations and onward to Kadıköy.
Quieter and greener than the Ataşehir valley — a good option for families wanting Asian side living.
The forest area is best in spring and autumn when the weather is mild.
Rents are more affordable here than in Kozyatağı or İçerenköy for similar quality.
